summary: The remediation-generation pack correctly terminates at CAS_BLOCKED: two Wolfram attempts exited 255 without a payload, three passing axes are not counted by majority vote, the four-axis scalar seal is false, identity_result and two_patch_measurement are null, and public_use is false. The prior collector, authorization-binding, exact-contract-inventory, Barrow--Tsagas moment-domain, supersession-binding, field-local qualifier, claim-ledger, and epistemic-status findings are remediated. Final closeout still fails with one P1 and one P2: the CAS-blocked mutation gate does not execute claim-surface mutations and permits a C2-to-C3 promotion while reporting all_detected=true, and the governing spec still classifies type I as externally closed although the module and result pack correctly classify it as internal definitional exactness.

claim_results.claim_tier_recommendation: Retain C2 as a ceiling, public_use=false, identity and measurement withheld, no physical witness, no x_C-wide Buchert-home claim, no geometry or family identification, and no native-transfer validation.
claim_results.reason: The scientific terminal route is safe, but the governing spec and its claim-mutation closeout evidence are not yet internally closed.

cas_adjudication.interpretation: Exit 255 with no parseable Wolfram payload is a platform-or-license blocker under the registered collector rule, not a mathematical counterexample and not a three-axis pass.

prior_finding_adjudication.detail: A content-addressed inventory and richer rows now exist, but the blocked-route rows are live assertions rather than executed claim mutations and omit the C2 ceiling. This is consolidated into F-PR170-FINAL-CLAIM-MUTATION.
The producer now binds canonical and mirrored backlog bytes plus semantic card hashes; the manifest binds both backlog inputs and the targeted test replays them.
The result is now explicitly cas_blocked_source_provenance_result with conditional internal-audit use only; no scalar result or algebraic witness is emitted.
The result card and manifest carry the stable claim_id, evidence_type, scientific/process status, claim tier, and separate blocked scientific state.

The generator reconstructs the collector output, requires exact equality with disk, binds the current contract and authorization, rejects collection errors, and enforces the exact CAS_BLOCKED status shape. The forged-collection regression passes.
The collector now binds exact assignment-file hashes and assignment context to the pre-axis authorization and rejects post-hoc assignment/context rewriting.
The collector validates exact non-vacuous source-input and per-axis source inventories plus frozen commands and required tools; deletion and substitution mutations are rejected.

The CAS_4AXIS_PASS branch has live claim mutations, but the active CAS_BLOCKED branch emits only six current-state assertions. The surviving closeout defect is consolidated into F-PR170-FINAL-CLAIM-MUTATION.

The module and result artifacts correctly split external type V from internal definitional type I, but pr170_spec.yaml still lists externally_closed_curvature_types as [I, V]. This remains F-PR170-FINAL-TYPE-I-SPEC.
barrow_tsagas_residual_q now rejects negative implied shear variance and negative mean shear; the hostile impossible-moment test passes.
The result and manifest use NO_CURRENTLY_AUTHENTICATED_X_C_WIDE_BUCHERT_HOME and explicitly define it as epistemic rather than an existence theorem.

findings.title: The CAS-blocked mutation gate can certify a claim-tier promotion

evidence.detail: The blocked branch registers six current-state booleans and labels them live_blocked_route_assertion; it does not run the claim-surface mutant validator used by the four-axis-pass branch.
All six rows cite one assertion node and contain no mutated_path, expected_violation, observed violation set, or claim-tier mutation.
The blocked-result test checks core withholding flags and the mutation tests trust the six detected booleans; no blocked-route C2 mutation is injected.

hostile_reproduction.mutation: Monkeypatch _metadata so every generated claim_level.level is C3, then call build() without writing files.
hostile_reproduction.expected: The claim-surface validator or an executed mutation gate rejects any level above the registered C2 ceiling.

findings.impact: A generator regression can promote the manifest-backed claim tier above the governing ceiling while check-mode reproducibility and the blocked-route mutation receipt remain green. Null scalar fields reduce scientific impact but do not make claim-tier drift acceptable.
findings.required_fix: Apply a blocked-route claim-surface validator before rendering; execute and record mutations for claim_id, C2 ceiling, public_use, source-provenance-only artifact mode, evidence/status typing, no-home semantics, forbidden uses, null scalar fields, and no family/native promotion. Require every mutant to produce its exact expected violation and add a regression for the C2-to-C3 case.
findings.kill_switch: Do not mark PR-170 complete or describe the blocked-route mutation evidence as claim-closeout complete.

findings.title: The governing spec still overstates type-I external provenance

evidence.detail: The remediated registry correctly marks I as INTERNAL_EXACT_DEFINITIONAL and only V as PASS external.
The blocked result correctly reports one external type-V construction plus one internal definitional type-I row.

findings.impact: The authoritative spec contradicts the safe generated pack and preserves the exact unsupported adjective identified by the prior physics reviewer. A later consumer can follow the spec instead of the module/result distinction.
findings.required_fix: Split the spec registry into externally authenticated [V], internal definitional exact [I], and the nine unresolved types; add an exact spec-to-module-to-result consistency test. Because the spec is contract-hash input, do not reuse old axis receipts after changing it; follow the registered fresh-contract/authorization route or an explicitly preregistered non-reuse terminal erratum route.
findings.kill_switch: Do not report type I as externally authenticated and do not close PR-170 while the governing spec retains [I, V] in the external list.

closeout_disposition.pr_status_recommendation: Keep PR-170 non-terminal. Preserve the current CAS_BLOCKED, null-result, public-use-false artifacts while remediating the two findings, then run a fresh hash-bound adjudication.

assumptions: Only the canonical context pack, the registered assignment, its fifteen required inputs, and its three explicitly allowed prior reviewer results were inspected as adjudication evidence.
The raw source archives and unassigned CAS-axis files were not independently reopened; collector and generator checks consumed their registered bindings internally.
The Wolfram exit-255 classification follows the registered remediation collector rule and the assignment's platform-blocked terminal instruction; it is not treated as a mathematical FAIL or PASS.
No broad repository discovery, web research, shared-file edit, status update, or production mutation was performed.
